summary: Phase 4 tested (Badla Streak Alert, Cup Night daily 8 pm, first-crown celebration, Colosseum entry show) on the backend and in the mobile web UI at 390/375/320 px, logged in as the QA learner PF37CC308. Backend: the given suites pass (test_rf_phase4 + test_rf_phase3, 9/9). A new suite test_iter65_cup_night_badla.py passes 2/2: an 18-joiner night split into 2 cups (9 real in a 16-seat cup + 8 in an 8-seat cup, ids night-<day>-1/2), and Badla filters (3-player, team and unfinished duels ignored; 401 without a token). UI passes: lobby Cup Night banner above Knockout with correct kicker and line; Badla strip shows Diya with BADLA PENDING, 'Lost 2 in a row', 5 dots (2 red) and BADLA LO. Tapping it opens rf-badla-sheet prefilled with Mixed Chemistry, then SEND BADLA opens the room 'Badla lo! 🔥', which was then cancelled. Cup Night screen in the soon phase: Colosseum stands hero, DOORS OPEN IN, steps 7:00 pm/8:00 pm, disabled footer. Doors phase: STARTS IN with an mm:ss countdown that ticks, then JOIN, then the joined panel and Leave, and the lobby banner reads 'YOU'RE IN ✓'. Live phase: the background loop seated the cup in about 7 s, the app jumped straight into the duel, the duel was forfeited, cup-title shows 'Cup Night #1', night-cup-1 shows the champion. Crown: an Open Cup of 4 made with FIND A CUP and won through the DB gave first_title=true; the modal shows the SVG crown, 'You are a Cup Champion!', SILVER CROWN with the right line, and SEE MY CROWN opens /rapid/player/PF37CC308. BUT on the first real visit the celebration had already been used up (see rca). Entry show: player-entry-show-colosseum shows a realistic Colosseum image that loads. Smoke tests pass: Knockout tile to /rapid/cup, Trophy ranks render. No deprecated Expo packages found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: A player who joined tonight's Cup Night can still open or join another cup (returns 200). At 8 pm seat_night quietly leaves them out because they are busy. But /cups/night still counts them (count 18 while 17 were seated) and returns joined=true, my_cup=null, with no message. Either block the other cup with a 409 while the player is joined for tonight (doors window), or remove them from uids at the draw and tell the client why.

Round 1 starts about 12.5 s after seating, and the loop runs every 10 s. Students who are not on the Cup Night or cup screen right at 8:00 miss cards. When I opened the app about 45 s late I was already on card 4/15. Consider a 30-60 s lead-in, or a push/inbox alert.
count = everyone in uids, even after the draw (it includes players who were not seated). Prefer the seated number once status is 'seated'.

ui_bugs.issue: The celebration is marked as seen (storage rf.crown.<cid>) as soon as the polled cup turns finished, even while the cup screen is not focused (the user is on the duel or result screen pushed on top). In my run, after winning the final in the UI flow and coming back to /rapid/cup/<cid>, the modal never showed because the key had already been set. After removing the key it showed correctly. Gate it on focused.current (or useIsFocused) and only call setItem once the modal is actually visible.

ui_bugs.component: Lobby Cup Night banner at 320 px (CupNight.tsx:78-80)
ui_bugs.issue: The kicker 'CUP NIGHT · DAILY 8...' and the line 'Doors open at 7:00 p...' are cut off with numberOfLines=1, so the countdown (the key information) is hidden on small phones. Allow 2 lines, or shorten the text (for example '7:00 pm · 7h 10m').

ui_bugs.component: Cup page on a hard reload right after a forfeit
ui_bugs.issue: Once, a direct page.goto of /rapid/cup/night-<day>-1 showed 'Your Rapid Fire session could not be verified. Please sign in again.' and the fallback title 'Knockout Cup'. Backend GETs returned 200, so this is the client grant race (generation !== rfGeneration, client.ts:303). It did not happen again on reload. The 'sign in again' wording is misleading for a race; retry automatically.

issues: cup-hub-night sits below the big Knockout hero (y≈400 at 390x844), not at the top as specified
When more than 1 h is left the countdown shows '7h 10m' and does not visibly tick every second. Only the under-1 h mm:ss format ticks. Fine if intended.
No ScrollView: at 375x667 the Continue button ends at y=665 of 667. On 320x568 phones the buttons will be cut off. Wrap the copy in a ScrollView or shrink the stage (minHeight 300).
Around 1.2 s the whole Colosseum is washed out by an almost white overlay. The arena is clearly visible at 0.4 s, so the flash is still strong despite the 'rays lighter' goal.

action_items: HIGH: CrownCelebration must only show and be stored as seen while the cup screen is focused (app/rapid/cup/[cid].tsx:111-115), otherwise the first-crown moment is lost when the cup ends while the user is on the duel result.
Fix the Cup Night lobby/hub banner at 320 px: the kicker and countdown line are cut off.
Block creating or joining another cup while joined for tonight's Cup Night (or remove such players at the draw and show the reason); make night count reflect seated players after the draw.
Consider a longer lead-in (30-60 s) before Cup Night round 1, plus an inbox/push alert at 8 pm.
Put a ScrollView around the CrownCelebration content for short screens; optionally move cup-hub-night to the top of the hub; tone down the white flash in EntryShow.
critical_code_review_comments: cups.py seat_night: split is balanced (ceil(n/16) groups) and protected by the status open->seating find_one_and_update; recovery for a 'seating' state stuck for more than 60 s is present. Good.
cups.py view(): first_title runs an extra query on every poll (every 2 s) for finished cups the viewer won; cheap but could be cached on the cup doc.
social.py badla: scans only the latest 300 1v1 duels across all opponents, so very active players may get an incomplete history for older friends (acceptable).
client.ts:303 error text 'sign in again' is shown for a generation race, not for real auth failures.
seed_data_creation: Used the pre-seeded social fixture (cleaned afterwards with `rf_social_fixture.py cleanup`). Created and removed: today's rf_cup_nights doc (2026-11-14), cup night-2026-11-14-1 plus its forfeited duel, Open Cup 32ff2670 plus 2 duels, their rf_awards/rf_learning_events/rf_feed rows, Badla room d44974e2 (cancelled). QA profile restored: coins, xp, badges, wins, streak, best_streak, cups_won (unset), exam_stats.JEE (xp 260, wins 0, cards_correct 12), cards_correct 12, duels 4, win_run 0; week_stats unset (all 3 matches in it were mine). Possible residue I could not verify: best_phoenix=15 on the QA profile may have come from my perfect duel. 18 TEST-i65 users were all removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: type phone and PIN at /entry with keyboard.type, then take localStorage jl_sid and inject it with add_init_script (it works across browser runs; a direct POST /api/rf/access with that sid from Python returns 401). Night helper: `python backend/tests/_iter65_night_ctl.py doors|live|state|restore`. Crown helper: run `python backend/tests/_iter65_crown.py watch` in the background, then press cup-create in the UI; afterwards run `restore`. That also needs rf_awards/rf_learning_events/rf_feed cleanup by duel ref plus exam_stats/week_stats fixes. Prefer adding those to the helper.
rca_of_issue: Crown not shown: [cid].tsx keeps polling while a duel screen is pushed on top. When status becomes finished with first_title, the effect calls setCrowned(true) and storage.setItem(rf.crown.<cid>) right away. The Modal belongs to an unfocused screen (on web it did not show over the duel screen), so when the user comes back the key is already set and nothing shows. Reproduced: key present, modal not visible; after deleting the key and reloading, the modal appears. Fix: require focus, for example `if (!isFocused) return;`, and add isFocused to the deps.
